note: v3442: The cross-family eye found 9 holes in the nine-condition classifier 20 minutes after it shipped. CPython 3.9.6 tests preexec_fn/cwd/uid/gid/gids with IDENTITY and only close_fds/pass_fds/start_new_session with truthiness; the classifier ran all seven through one elif val:, and its loop variable must_be_falsy was declared and NEVER READ. So user=0 (running as root), group=0, cwd= and extra_groups=() were reported SPAWNS and every one of them forks. Driven: 9/9 correct after the fix, with the note naming the trap. 3 red-proofs — and S3 proves that turning the non-literal branch into UNKNOWN, which one finding literally asked for, would have blinded the gate to the six sites v3441 just repaired. Also registers EYE_CWD in the import-bound path registry, closing another of the 28 CI reds.
